title: aih-extensions source declaration, schema version 1
description: Public source data for the aih-extensions framework identity, pinned upstream provenance, owner-intended content groups and source-scoped compatibility facts. Source intent only: not an install plan, not a support claim, not an observed binding.

schemaVersion.description: Versions this source format independently of the product release. Only 1 is defined.

versionSource.description: Where the canonical release version is authored; the declaration references it instead of copying a version number.

source.description: The authored file these pins are taken from.

vendored.description: true when upstream content is copied into this repository by the vendor script; false when the upstream is installed from its own repository at this commit and never vendored here.

groups.description: The content owner's intended groups. Every member must resolve to existing authored content in the distributed source. The same member may appear in several distinct groups; a duplicate inside one group is invalid. Groups the owner did not intend are omitted, never invented.

source.description: The authored metadata this grouping is taken from.

facts.description: Source-scoped compatibility facts and limitations. A fact never prescribes a per-tool install location, never marks a tool as supported and never claims an observed Core binding. Facts of kind 'verified' must carry evidence; absent evidence stays absent (null) and a fact without evidence must not be presented as verified.

tool.description: A stable public Core tool identifier, or 'all'. Used only to reference a known tool, never to claim an unobserved binding.

source.description: The authored repository file this fact is recorded in.
